title: Spotlight on… Bengaluru
summary: This C40 case study describes “Spotlight on… Bengaluru,” an urban initiative documented for Bengaluru. It is included because it addresses air pollution pm25 hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Chief Commissioner Tushar Giri Nath showcases Bengaluru’s efforts to prioritise green spaces, reduce pollution, and monitor air quality.

intervention.objectives: Chief Commissioner Tushar Giri Nath showcases Bengaluru’s efforts to prioritise green spaces, reduce pollution, and monitor air quality.
